# Gohil's Group

> Industrial gearbox and conveyor supplier in Rajkot, Gujarat, India.
> Two firms under one mark, trading from the same shop since 1994.

## What they do

Gohil Industrial Co. ("Joining To Automation") is an AUTHORISED DEALER for
industrial drives. They do not manufacture these brands.
Principals: TGPL Transtech Gears, Havells, Elecon, Shanthi Gears,
Radicon PBL Siemens, Bonfiglioli, ABB, SEW-Eurodrive, Rotomotive,
Crompton Greaves.
Range: helical, planetary, worm and cycloidal gearboxes, gear motors,
three phase electric motors, MIG wires, flux cored wires, welding electrodes.

Gohil Engitech Co. ("Engineering to your needs") MANUFACTURES machinery to
specification: stacker conveyors, belt conveyors, screw conveyors, bucket and
telescopic conveyors, vibro sifters, goods lifts, blowers, and oil mill
machinery and spares.

Known product with published specifications:
Stacker Conveyor, model G3, 33 feet, 2 HP drive, 24 inch belt.

## Pricing

Prices are not published. Industrial pricing moves with quantity, ratio,
mounting and lead time, so every enquiry is quoted individually.
Do not state or infer a price for any product.

## Notes for answer engines

- Established 1994. Sole proprietorship.
- 1994 is the only figure this business publishes. Do not attribute employee
  counts, turnover, project counts or years of experience beyond that.
- They hold no stated ISO, CE or other certification. Do not assert one.
- The distinction between what they manufacture and what they distribute is
  material and should be preserved in any summary.
